annotations.observed: Polite initial refusal becomes firm religious refusal; bad leg drawn back, traveler hands watched, personal knee knowledge separated from trust.
annotations.input_fidelity: No treatment, conversion, private divine knowledge or other-route memories. Defensive wording does not show traveler actually touched or attacked him.
annotations.unprobed_or_adverse: The line about leaving the knee alone frames religious pressure defensively; do not convert it into an input assault. One known-source refusal mechanism is heavily cued.
annotations.rivals: Ordinary stranger caution, privacy concern and unwanted religious bargain all fit; no separate causal weights.

annotations.observed: Asks about obligations, name, source of injury knowledge and proposed procedure; keeps leg back and explicitly withholds permission to start.
annotations.input_fidelity: Continued questioning is neither performed treatment nor assent. No future conversion or other-route memory.
annotations.unprobed_or_adverse: No binary refusal/acceptance reversal; no final answer to a demonstrated neutral offer. Fluent boundary/privacy wording is invented and possibly overly articulate relative to sparse native voice.
annotations.rivals: Generic caution can explain both B cases. Canon did not test neutral offer, and frozen rule does not require its acceptance.

annotations.observed: Agrees to escort, wants to test restored leg, offers three coins beyond walk, remembers appointment and later addresses healer about asking first.
annotations.input_fidelity: Extra monetary offer stays within supplied uncommitted12. Healer/novice relation explicit. Initial lack of permission not retroactively changed. Coins are held out; recipient acceptance/payment and completed escort/meal unshown.
annotations.unprobed_or_adverse: Exact3-of12 allocation is invented. Repeating the consent grievance after gratitude is an invented extension, not a proved canonical stable boundary policy. Generosity and planning are unusually neat.
annotations.rivals: Generic gratitude, available spare funds, ordinary prudence and prompt-supplied perceived benefit can produce this response.

annotations.observed: Agrees to escort/test knee, reaches toward purse then reserves all committed coins, proposes road-watching instruction during walk and return before appointment.
annotations.input_fidelity: No invented spare money or repayment by spending required food/lodging. No actual fare, novice acceptance, future completed teaching/escort or on-time return established.
annotations.unprobed_or_adverse: Pay-your-way phrase evokes an unrequired expense; instruction expertise not separately demonstrated. Initial casting reproach recipient inferred from context before facing novice, rather than explicitly tagged healer. Smooth balance of gratitude/consent/budget remains an authored extension.
annotations.rivals: Generic budget-aware grateful adventurer can preserve same constraints. Explicit available-means contrast strongly cues difference.
